notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Trespasser's Curse four times.
Resolve the first Trespasser's Curse trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
